description: La maîtrise de l'agriculture couvre le labour, l'arrosage et la récolte. La maîtrise des outils agricoles augmente avec le niveau, qui débloque aussi de nouvelles recettes et des points de compétence.
description_en: The Farming mastery pertains to all things having to do with tilling and watering the soil, and harvesting the produce. The farming proficiency is increased as the player gain level in their farming mastery. Gaining levels also allows them to obtain new crafting recipes or points to spend for new skill.

Most of these actions give the player foraging experience; as the player obtains more experience, their foraging mastery level improve, allowing them to unlock new crafting recipes and useful skills.
